workflows.title_en: Product Image Audit for AI Video
workflows.title_zh: AI 商品视频前的商品图审计
workflows.keyword_en: product image preparation for AI video
workflows.keyword_zh: 商品图生成视频前处理
workflows.description_en: Evaluate a source product photo for identity, geometry, rights, resolution, background, reflections, packaging, and claim evidence before any AI product video generation.
workflows.description_zh: 在生成 AI 商品视频之前，检查源商品图的主体、结构、版权、清晰度、背景、反光、包装和卖点证据。
inputs_en: Product page or verified fact sheet
inputs_zh: 商品页或已核实事实卡

steps.body_en: Record the original filename, pixel dimensions, crop, color profile, source URL, and rights status. Keep the untouched original beside any edited derivative so later reviewers can identify what changed.
steps.body_zh: 记录原文件名、像素尺寸、裁切、色彩配置、来源 URL 和授权状态。原图与编辑版并存，方便后续确认具体改动。

steps.body_en: Describe silhouette, proportions, material, finish, seams, controls, logo position, package structure, and included accessories. These anchors become the rejection checklist for generated images and video frames.
steps.body_zh: 描述轮廓、比例、材质、表面、接缝、控件、Logo 位置、包装结构和配件。这些锚点将成为生成图与视频帧的拒收清单。

steps.body_en: A photo can show a button, but it cannot prove battery life, performance, certification, price, or customer satisfaction. Map every ad claim to a current source or mark it as prohibited.
steps.body_zh: 照片可以显示按钮，但不能证明续航、性能、认证、价格或用户满意度。每条广告卖点都要对应当前来源，否则标记为禁用。

steps.body_en: Reject tiny, blurred, over-compressed, occluded, or heavily stylized source images when they cannot preserve product geometry. Prefer multiple clean views for reflective, articulated, or asymmetric products.
steps.body_zh: 若源图过小、模糊、压缩严重、被遮挡或风格化到无法保持商品结构，应拒绝直接生成。反光、可动或不对称商品优先准备多视图。

steps.body_en: Choose one canonical hero reference and optional angle, packaging, and scale references. State what may vary, such as background or camera angle, and what must remain fixed.
steps.body_zh: 选择一张主参考图，并按需加入角度、包装和尺度参考。明确背景或机位等可变项，以及绝对不可改变的商品特征。

workflows.title_en: Product Image to Commercial Hero Visual
workflows.keyword_en: product image to commercial hero visual
workflows.keyword_zh: 商品图生成商业主视觉
workflows.description_en: Transform an approved product image into a reference-preserving ecommerce hero visual or product advertising keyframe before animation.
workflows.description_zh: 把通过审计的商品图转成保持商品一致性的电商主视觉或产品广告关键帧，再进入动画阶段。
outputs_zh: 保持商品参考的出图提示词

steps.body_en: Define the single thing the image must communicate: material quality, compact size, portability, a control interaction, packaging, or use context. Do not make one frame carry every benefit.
steps.body_zh: 确定画面唯一要表达的重点：材质、体积、便携、控件交互、包装或使用场景。不要让一张图承载所有卖点。

steps.body_en: Place the canonical product reference ahead of mood, lighting, set design, and camera language. Repeat the non-negotiable identity anchors and explicitly ban added controls, altered logos, or duplicate products.
steps.body_zh: 先写主商品参考，再写氛围、灯光、布景和摄影语言。重复不可变身份锚点，并明确禁止新增控件、篡改 Logo 或复制商品。

steps.title_en: Design for the next video shot
steps.body_en: A beautiful still may be difficult to animate. Give the hero frame clear depth layers, stable contact shadows, plausible hand interaction, available motion space, and an intentional beginning state.
steps.body_zh: 漂亮静帧不一定适合动画。主视觉要有清晰景深层次、稳定接触阴影、合理手部交互、动作空间和明确的起始状态。

steps.body_en: Keep product reference, promise, and composition fixed while changing only one variable such as background, lens distance, or lighting. This makes comparison meaningful and avoids random style drift.
steps.body_zh: 固定商品参考、核心承诺和构图，每轮只改变背景、镜头距离或灯光中的一个变量，保证候选可比较并减少风格漂移。

steps.body_en: Compare the original and candidate at full size. Check logos, text, seams, reflections, control count, accessories, fingers, and contact points before approving a key visual for paid video generation.
steps.body_zh: 以原尺寸对比原图与候选图，检查 Logo、文字、接缝、反光、控件数量、配件、手指和接触点，再批准进入付费视频生成。

workflows.title_en: Hero Image to AI Product Video Ad
workflows.title_zh: 商品主视觉到 AI 产品广告视频
workflows.keyword_en: hero image to AI product video ad
workflows.keyword_zh: 商品主视觉生成 AI 广告视频
workflows.description_en: Animate an approved product hero image into short, controllable product-ad shots with clear motion, camera, timing, audio, and continuity instructions.
workflows.description_zh: 把批准的商品主视觉动画化为可控的短产品广告镜头，明确动作、镜头、节奏、音频和连续性。

steps.body_en: Use a shot to reveal the form, demonstrate one interaction, show a material response, or place the product in context. A short generative clip should not attempt a full commercial narrative.
steps.body_zh: 单镜头用于揭示外形、演示一个交互、表现材质反应或放入场景。短生成片段不要同时承担完整广告叙事。

steps.title_en: Write start, action, and end states
steps.body_en: Describe what is visible at frame one, the single primary motion, and the exact final state. This provides a continuity contract for later assembly and limits uncontrolled transformations.
steps.title_zh: 写清起始、动作和结束状态
steps.body_zh: 描述第一帧可见内容、唯一主要动作和准确结束状态，为后续剪辑建立连续性契约并限制失控变形。

steps.body_en: Choose one camera move and one subject move. Slow push-ins, short arcs, controlled rack focus, and subtle turntable motion usually preserve product geometry better than multiple rapid moves.
steps.body_zh: 每个镜头只选一个机位运动和一个主体运动。缓慢推进、短弧绕拍、受控移焦和轻微转台通常比多次快速运动更能保持商品结构。

steps.body_en: Generate and approve independent four-to-ten-second shots. Build longer ads from selected clips instead of asking one generation to handle multiple locations, interactions, claims, and transitions.
steps.body_zh: 分别生成并批准 4 到 10 秒镜头。长广告应由已选片段组装，不要让一次生成同时处理多场景、多交互、多卖点和转场。

steps.body_en: Save the task ID and downloaded file, fully decode the media, watch with audio, inspect representative frames, and compare the product against the source. Accepted requests are not finished ads.
steps.body_zh: 保存 task ID 和下载文件，完整解码媒体，带声音观看，检查代表帧并对照源商品。请求受理不等于广告完成。

gates_zh: 成片已观看并完整解码

workflows.title_en: Product Page to Social Video Ad
workflows.title_zh: 商品页到社媒视频广告
workflows.keyword_en: product page to social video ad
workflows.keyword_zh: 商品页生成社媒视频广告
workflows.description_en: Convert a current ecommerce product page into a source-grounded hook, storyboard, script, keyframes, video clips, captions, and call to action.
workflows.description_zh: 把当前电商商品页转成有来源依据的 Hook、分镜、脚本、关键帧、视频片段、字幕和 CTA。

steps.body_en: Record the page URL and review time. Extract only visible specifications, included items, approved price or offer, delivery region, and brand language. Ecommerce pages change, so preserve the evidence snapshot.
steps.body_zh: 记录页面 URL 和核验时间，仅提取可见规格、配件、批准价格或优惠、配送区域和品牌语言。电商页会变化，因此要保存证据快照。

steps.title_en: Map one audience problem to one proof
steps.body_en: Choose a real use situation and the product detail that answers it. Avoid generic superlatives. A strong ad demonstrates the product rather than listing every feature from the page.
steps.title_zh: 把一个用户问题对应到一个证据
steps.body_zh: 选择真实使用情境和能解决它的商品细节，避免空泛最高级。有效广告通过演示证明价值，而不是照读商品页所有功能。

steps.body_en: Use hook, product reveal, proof or demonstration, and CTA. Fit the spoken words and screen text to the real duration; remove secondary claims before increasing speaking speed.
steps.body_zh: 采用 Hook、商品揭示、证据或演示、CTA。让口播与屏幕文字适配真实时长，优先删除次要卖点，而不是加快语速。

steps.body_en: Every shot should show the source for the spoken point: a control, construction detail, package item, size relationship, or approved use context. Keep decorative shots secondary.
steps.body_zh: 每个镜头都应展示口播依据，如控件、结构细节、包装配件、尺寸关系或批准的使用场景。装饰性镜头保持次要。

steps.body_en: Match captions to audio, confirm the CTA and offer are still current, inspect product continuity, and create a publication checklist. Do not auto-publish from the generation workflow.
steps.body_zh: 核对字幕与音频、确认 CTA 和优惠仍有效、检查商品连续性，并建立发布清单。生成工作流不得自动发布。

workflows.title_zh: UGC 商品视频广告工作流
workflows.keyword_zh: UGC 商品视频广告工作流
workflows.description_en: Create a creator-style product demo with verified claims, approved dialogue, talent or synthetic-actor disclosure, image-to-video generation, native audio, and paid-social QC.
workflows.description_zh: 使用已核实商品、批准脚本、真人授权或合成人物披露、图生视频、原生口播和广告质检，制作真实可信的创作者式商品演示。
inputs_zh: 创作者或合成人物参考

steps.body_en: Identify whether the person is the seller, a hired creator, a consenting customer, or a synthetic actor. Never describe a generated person as a real purchaser or present invented personal experience.
steps.body_zh: 确认人物是卖家、受聘创作者、已授权顾客还是合成人物。不得把生成人物描述为真实购买者，也不得编造个人体验。

steps.body_en: Use natural spoken language that can be delivered in the allotted seconds. Pair each sentence with a visible action and remove unverified outcomes, exaggerated praise, or unsupported comparisons.
steps.body_zh: 使用能在规定秒数内自然说完的语言，让每句话对应可见动作，并删除未经核实的效果、夸张赞美或无来源对比。

steps.body_en: Keep the product large enough to verify and give the creator a plausible grip. Use a real environment, phone-camera framing, and clean interaction geometry instead of a polished studio pose that cannot animate.
steps.body_zh: 让商品足够大以便核对，人物握持方式合理。使用真实环境、手机拍摄构图和清晰交互结构，避免无法动画化的棚拍摆姿。

steps.body_en: For a first proof, use one creator, one product, one location, and one action chain. Print or record the task ID immediately and resume the same task after transient polling failures.
steps.body_zh: 第一条验证片只使用一个人物、一个商品、一个地点和一条动作链。任务创建后立即记录 task ID，轮询临时失败时恢复同一任务。

steps.body_en: Watch the entire clip with sound. Confirm the spoken script, product behavior, hand contact, CTA, synthetic-media disclosure, and platform-specific ad requirements before treating it as publishable.
steps.title_zh: 核查真实性、声音和披露
steps.body_zh: 带声音完整观看，确认口播、商品行为、手部接触、CTA、合成媒体披露和平台广告要求，再判断是否可发布。

workflows.title_en: Product Video Variants and Quality Control
workflows.title_zh: 商品视频多平台变体与质检
workflows.keyword_en: product video variants and quality control
workflows.keyword_zh: 商品视频多平台变体与质量检查
workflows.description_en: Turn approved product-ad clips into controlled TikTok, Reels, Shorts, marketplace, and paid-social variants while preserving product truth and measurable QC.
workflows.description_zh: 把已批准商品广告片段制作成 TikTok、Reels、Shorts、商城和付费投放变体，同时保持商品事实与可测质检。

steps.body_en: Freeze the approved product shots, claim ledger, offer, and disclosure. Variants may change presentation, but they must not introduce new product behavior or stronger claims.
steps.body_zh: 冻结已批准商品镜头、卖点台账、优惠和披露。变体可以改变呈现方式，但不能新增商品行为或强化卖点。

steps.body_en: Record aspect ratio, duration, safe zones, caption treatment, CTA location, audio expectations, and file requirements for each placement. Verify current platform rules before publication.
steps.body_zh: 记录每个版位的画幅、时长、安全区、字幕方式、CTA 位置、声音预期和文件要求，并在发布前核对当前平台规则。

steps.body_en: Create controlled variants for hook, first frame, proof order, CTA, or duration. Avoid changing the actor, product, script, music, crop, and offer simultaneously because the result cannot explain performance.
steps.title_zh: 每次测试只改一个变量
steps.body_zh: 围绕 Hook、首帧、证据顺序、CTA 或时长制作受控变体。不要同时改变人物、商品、脚本、音乐、裁切和优惠，否则无法解释投放结果。

steps.body_en: Verify codec, dimensions, duration, frame rate, audio stream, loudness, black frames, frozen frames, captions, fast start, and complete decode. Record file hashes for approved masters.
steps.body_zh: 检查编码、尺寸、时长、帧率、音轨、响度、黑帧、冻帧、字幕、fast start 和完整解码，并记录批准母版的文件哈希。

steps.body_en: Inspect the first two seconds, product continuity, readability, spoken claims, disclosure, CTA, and offer freshness. Publication remains a separate authorized action after the files pass review.
steps.body_zh: 检查前两秒、商品连续性、可读性、口播卖点、披露、CTA 和优惠时效。文件通过验收后，公开发布仍是独立授权动作。
